title: Kenyan Doubanjiang Fried Rice Bowl
description: A twist on traditional fried rice, this Kenyan-inspired dish combines spicy doubanjiang with springy vegetables.

ingredients.name: kenyan vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as sweet potatoes, carrots, and peas

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped spring onion and cook until softened, about 2 minutes.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the doubanjiang and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the Kenyan vegetables to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the fried rice in a bowl and garnish with additional spring onion if desired.
Drizzle with light soy sauce to taste.
